newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Dollar/yen vol bought as G7 protection.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Dollar/yen vol bought as G7 protection.

text.p: Implied volatility on dollar/yen options ratcheted up on Wednesday, hitting its highest levels since spot collapsed to seven-month lows last week.
Traders said dollar/yen vol would remain firm ahead of the Group of Seven summit on June 20-22, as players protected themselves against possible G7-inspired spot moves.

"The last couple of times before G7 meetings, dollar/yen volatilities have gone into G7 progressively higher, so the week before they get bought and bought and then on the Monday they're lower again," said a senior options dealer at a U.S. bank.
One-month dollar/yen vol was trading at 13.0/13.3 percent at 0804 GMT, up from late Tuesday's European level of 12.7/13.1.
"Ahead of the G7 at the weekend we view it as unlikely there will be any sell-off in vols on fear of aggressive breaks lower," said an options trader at another U.S. bank here.
Dealers said fear that spot would lurch downwards was keeping dollar/yen vols in demand, with strong interest in downside strikes a key factor.
Spot dollar/yen dipped beneath 113 yen in Asia overnight after Japan's May trade surplus came in even bigger than expected, jumping 222.2 percent year-on-year.
